auditor: Senior Machine Learning & Risk Intelligence Auditor

feature_count_reconciliation.documentation_discrepancy_explanation: Previous documentation inconsistently cited 12 features, 19 features, and 24 features. The exact accounting is: 10 raw columns, 14 engineered features added in code. Dropping 2 identifiers leaves 21 pre-encoding features for post-transaction detection (1 categorical + 20 numerical), expanding to 24 columns after drop-first one-hot encoding.

features.name: step
features.description: Simulation time step in hours (1 to 95)
features.potential_issues: Discrete hourly step; unbounded if simulator continues past 95

features.name: type
features.description: Transaction channel / financial instrument type

features.name: amount
features.description: Transaction monetary value in currency units ($)
features.potential_issues: Heavy right skew, values up to $10M

features.name: oldbalanceOrg
features.description: Sender initial balance immediately prior to execution

features.name: oldbalanceDest
features.description: Recipient initial balance prior to execution
features.data_source: Recipient core ledger balance enquiry (when accessible)
features.potential_issues: Unpopulated for merchant accounts (M-series accounts recorded as 0.0)

features.name: newbalanceOrig
features.description: Sender post-execution ledger balance
features.potential_issues: Target leakage in pre-transaction authorization switch
features.handling: Strictly excluded from Pre-Transaction screening model

features.name: newbalanceDest
features.description: Recipient post-execution ledger balance
features.potential_issues: Target leakage in pre-transaction authorization switch
features.handling: Strictly excluded from Pre-Transaction screening model

features.name: transaction_hour
features.description: Hour of the day derived cyclically (0-23)

features.name: transaction_day
features.description: Calendar day index (1, 2, 3...)

features.name: transaction_amount_log
features.description: Log1p transformed transaction amount
features.potential_issues: Negative amounts would fail log; guarded with maximum(0)

features.name: merchant_destination
features.description: Flag indicating recipient is a merchant account

features.name: amount_to_oldbalance_orig_ratio
features.description: Ratio of requested amount to sender's starting balance
features.potential_issues: Division by zero when oldbalanceOrg is 0; extreme ratios

features.name: orig_has_zero_balance
features.description: Flag indicating sender account has zero balance at initiation

features.name: dest_has_zero_balance
features.description: Flag indicating recipient account has zero balance at initiation

features.name: origin_balance_difference
features.description: Actual monetary reduction in sender account balance

features.name: destination_balance_difference
features.description: Actual monetary increase in recipient account balance

features.name: balance_error_orig
features.description: Accounting discrepancy in sender ledger (expected balance - actual new balance)
features.potential_issues: Near-deterministic fraud signature in synthetic data; requires post-state

features.name: balance_error_dest
features.description: Accounting discrepancy in recipient ledger (expected balance - actual new balance)

features.name: origin_balance_zero
features.description: Flag indicating sender account was completely drained to zero ($0.00)

features.name: destination_balance_zero
features.description: Flag indicating recipient account still has zero balance post-transaction

features.name: empty_account_flag
features.description: Flag indicating requested amount exactly matched starting sender balance
features.potential_issues: Captures intention to drain account; mathematically available pre-transaction
features.handling: Approved for both models with documented rationale

features.name: error_orig_zero
features.description: Flag indicating sender ledger balanced with exact zero error

features.name: error_dest_zero
features.description: Flag indicating recipient ledger balanced with exact zero error

pipeline_leakage_audit.finding: Previously, ColumnTransformer was fitted on the entire X_train before cross-validation search, leaking scaling and imputation parameters across training folds.
pipeline_leakage_audit.correction: Refactored to full Scikit-Learn / Imbalanced-Learn Pipelines where ColumnTransformer is fitted strictly inside each cross-validation fold.
pipeline_leakage_audit.threshold_selection_finding: Previously, out-of-fold probabilities were calculated manually after full preprocessor fitting. Refactored to out-of-fold CV predictions using fold-isolated pipelines.
